data.body:
[P1] Include deadline-property lookup in the protected read

A platform context with a throwing `getRemainingTimeInMillis` getter still fails both AI operations: this property lookup occurs before the `try`. SDK invariant 4 requires a throwing deadline read to mean no deadline, and the base execution-context implementation protects both lookup and invocation. Move the lookup into the protected block and cover a throwing accessor, asserting that the operation succeeds with only its step cancellation signal.
